blocks.text: A PostgreSQL table defines the fields used by the API. A primary key gives each record a stable id.

Use the Supabase local CLI with its required container runtime, then run supabase init and supabase start in a practice project. Use the local URL and public key reported by its status command. SQL runs in the local database tools.

blocks.code: CREATE TABLE public.cma_books(id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,title text NOT NULL,pages integer CHECK(pages>0));
blocks.title: Create a local sample table

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A primary key identifies a row and prevents duplicate key values. Related records can refer to that key.
`NOT NULL` requires a value to be present. It is a separate rule from numeric range checks.
`CHECK` tests a stored value against a rule, such as a non-negative count. Use NOT NULL too when missing values are forbidden.

blocks.text: The local database has an empty sample table for books.
